source_text.body:
Build a weekly portfolio brief automatically
The author used Claude Cowork with an FMP connector to generate a weekly investment portfolio brief from a small dataset, reporting about two weeks of use.
More AI trading agents
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The author used the FMP connector in Claude Cowork to build a weekly portfolio brief from an intentionally small dataset. It covers only the stocks they own. Each report consolidates current price, valuation metrics, analyst consensus, moving averages and price targets, limited to the parameters the author set.
How it went
After a little over two weeks, the author says the brief lets them process everything in minutes instead of spending an hour hopping between sources. The source gives no accuracy checks or other measurements.
Worth knowing
Keeping the dataset small and the parameters fixed is what keeps the report focused. The source doesn't give setup steps or costs, though the article's subtitle says the feature makes the Pro plan worth it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Using my holdings in [file or folder with tickers and share counts] and the FMP connector for market data, create a weekly portfolio brief as a [Word doc or PDF]. Include performance versus [benchmark], the biggest movers, notable news or earnings for each holding, and anything that deserves my attention this week. The job is done when the brief is saved in [folder] and you've told me what data you used and anything you couldn't verify.
Original source: https://www.xda-developers.com/i-used-claude-cowork-to-automate-my-research-and-it-builds-my-weekly-reports-while-i-sleep/
